description: The AAS SD Card is a high-capacity microSDXC memory card offering a generous 128GB of storage space, making it an ideal choice for those who need reliable and expansive storage on the go. Rated as Class 10 and UHS Speed Class 1 (U1), this card delivers consistently fast read and write speeds, ensuring smooth performance whether you are capturing high-definition videos, storing large photo libraries, or running applications directly from the card. The microSDXC format makes it compatible with a wide range of devices, including smartphones, tablets, action cameras, dash cams, and more. Its compact form factor means it fits neatly into any compatible slot without adding any bulk. Whether you are a photography enthusiast looking to expand your camera's storage or simply need extra space on your mobile device, this 128GB microSDXC card provides the capacity and speed to keep up with your demands. Please ensure your device supports the microSDXC format and UHS-I interface before purchasing
